# HaveTickets

> Cinema ticketing and seat reservation demo built with .NET 10, Clean Architecture and Blazor WebAssembly, with a deterministic engine that prevents overbooking.

- [Live demo](https://tickets.naindev.com/): browse movies and showtimes, pick seats and reserve tickets
- [Source code](https://github.com/Nain9Dev/HaveTickets): domain, API, Blazor and Vue clients, architecture and concurrency tests
- [NainDev](https://www.naindev.com/): the author's main site and project ecosystem
